title: Monster Girls Dice Board
synopsis: On the mysterious Mysteria Island, embark on an exciting dice adventure with charming and unique monster girls! Use strategic board game mechanics to collect resources, buy lands, and compete in friendly matches while building heartwarming bonds and exploring the fantastical island together!

title: Water Maid
synopsis: Water Maid is all about fetching water. Run, jump and dash to avoid enemies and find the elusive fresh water springs scattered around the island. Fill up your pot and make it back to the village, safe and sound.

title: Cafe Simulator
synopsis: Build and manage your cafe business. Customize your shop with furniture and decorations, brew various beverages, serve customers efficiently, expand your space, and compete with rival cafés. Grow from a small shop to a thriving empire. Oh, and there's chicken wrestling too.

title: Snake Echos
synopsis: "Snake Echos: your trail hardens into deadly walls. Loop enemies into your own path, level up with Magnet/Fireball/Scythe abilities, survive escalating chaos with blocks and lasers. Solo leaderboard + Duel mode. 3 difficulty tiers.

title: IWA Fighting Adventure
synopsis: A feature-packed autobattler where you build and develop your own settlement, gather resources, prepare for battle, and lead your forces on dangerous expeditions and auto-battles.

title: Cruisopolis: Cruise Line Tycoon
synopsis: Cruisopolis: Cruise Line Tycoon is a management and building simulation about running a cruise line. Players start with a small river cruiser on the Rhine and work up through the shipyard to a coastal cruiser, a mid-size liner, a resort ship and a megaship, designing each ship's interior deck by deck inside a fixed hull: cabins from interior rooms to balcony suites, dining rooms and buffets, bars, pools, a theatre, a spa, a water park, galleys, stores, the laundry, crew quarters, the engine room and the bridge. They hire and schedule the crew, run power, fresh water, sewage, air conditioning and fuel, plan itineraries on the Rhine, along the Norwegian coast and through the Caribbean, and price cabins for simulated guests who write reviews after each voyage. Ships float on modelled weight and balance, and a sandbox mode can set off events such as a kraken, pirates, lightning storms, rogue waves and capsizes. The game has a six-chapter campaign, a sandbox and a creative mode.

title: How Many Tickets Does It Take To Win The Lottery?
originalTitle: How Many Tickets Does It Take To Win The Lottery?
synopsis: Have you ever wondered, how many tickets does it take to win the lottery? Scratch tickets, match the numbers and spend your winnings on more tickets, until you are scratching millions at a time. The jackpot odds are realistic, 1 in 290,472,336, and nothing you buy changes it.

title: Scopecreep
synopsis: A whispering flame craves souls. With each offering, your resolve strengthens. Fight spirits, collect their essences, and feed a hunger that may never subside in this short active incremental.

title: NodalBastion
synopsis: Defend the last AI core in an abstract minimalist game of incremental progression, powerful skills, and evolving networks.

title: Trees Hate You
synopsis: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

title: Func Key
synopsis: Func Key is a spelling roguelike deck builder where your keyboard is the deck! Customize your keyboard to be the ultimate spelling machine, or leave words behind with rule breaking mods. Spell, build, and relax, all to the soothing thock of the keyboard.

title: Clicky Islands
synopsis: Clicky Islands is a unique blend of incremental gameplay, clicker mechanics, city-builder elements, and resource management. You play as a governor appointed by the king to discover and develop a new island for his future kingdom.

title: Tekken 8: Roger Jr.
synopsis: Acompanhe o lançamento deste jogo confirmado na base oficial da Twitch / IGDB.

title: Topdeck Automat
synopsis: The roguelike auto-battler where your deck prints itself. Supply a brave worker droid with synergistic blueprints to defend the planet against hordes of alien invaders. Combine hundreds of cards with custom upgrades and infinitely stackable modules to discover broken builds.

title: Highland Haven
synopsis: Discover your own private haven in the Scottish Highlands and bring this once thriving home for hairy “coos” back to life. Craft goodies to sell, optimize your farm, and grow a pasture of cute highland cows roaming free on the bottom of your screen in this relaxing idle game.

title: Dice Looter
synopsis: Roll the dice to collect loot, combine your gear, and discover powerful builds. Dice Looter is a roguelike autobattler where your hero enters battle to become the greatest warrior among mortals.

title: Pegs of Hell
synopsis: A physics roguelike where you build the pachinko board yourself. Place and upgrade pegs, arrange powerful Arcana, split balls, trigger elemental chains and create absurd scoring machines before Hell's rent catches up with you.

title: Raise, Rise & Die
synopsis:
Raise, Rise & Die is a dark fantasy deckbuilder adapted from a physical card game. In solo Arena runs, players face automated enemy decks, collect new cards, and build synergies to climb the leaderboard.
Every card has a Soul Value that determines its cost to play, the Reserve it generates when sacrificed, and the health lost when it falls as the face-up Top Soul. Between battles, sacrificing cards from the deck restores health, creating a choice between preserving a powerful build and surviving the next encounter.
The game also features online one-on-one duels and Ancients’ Path, an editor for creating and sharing custom runs.

title: Who Gave Them Weapons
synopsis: Build your crazy squad in this cartoony auto-battler and watch as it turns into total chaos! Equip teams with the silliest gear, crush friends online, or beat enemies in solo challenges. Mix and match warriors, discover powerful combos, and prove your strategy is more insane than the chaos.

title: Trafficity
synopsis: A city builder focused on traffic. Build out your city with gridless road tools. Fix traffic jams with roundabouts, fully-customizable traffic lights, or sprawling highway interchanges. Keep traffic flowing as you expand to a vast metropolis.

title: Rock and Found
synopsis: Your Grandma has willed you a collection of rocks deep in the woods, but when you arrive, you find that the rocks are strewn across the floor. Armed with your Grandma's journal, a determination to clean the collection, and the tools she left behind, you begin sorting through thousands of rocks.

title: Here Comes the Horde
synopsis: Here Comes the Horde is an auto-battler incremental game where your loyal soldiers fight against hordes of undead enemies led by a formidable necromancer. Earn coins, improve your army, unlock new units, grow stronger, and fill the screen with your troops.

title: Of Dice and Minions
synopsis: Of Dice and Minions is a pixel-art dice-rolling auto-battler roguelite developed and published by Foorbytes. Each turn the player rolls five dice, holding and rerolling them in the style of Yahtzee. Every die represents a minion type, and the number rolled determines how many of that minion are summoned. The resulting poker hand grants a bonus, such as extra units, increased damage or health, or sending all five dice into battle, after which the army fights automatically. A run descends 100 floors across ten zones, with a boss every tenth floor whose own dice rolls summon reinforcements, and continues into an Endless mode after the final floor.

title: My Little Ranch
synopsis: A cozy horse ranch that lives on your desktop while you work, or in full screen when you don't. Feed your horses, send them running together, race for coins, hire ranch hands and grow your ranch.

title: Aurora Requiem: The Lullaby of Calvaris
originalTitle: Aurora Requiem: The Lullaby of Calvaris
synopsis: Year 41 without the sun. Inside the skeleton of a colossal sea creature, the lighthouses burn memories for light. A late-90s-style JRPG with pre-rendered backdrops, three discs, time-gauge battles and a mechanic with a giant wrench who always keeps his word.

title: Dungeonbound
synopsis: Dungeonbound is a retro first-person auto-battler dungeon crawler. Send your Warrior, Mage or Rogue into monster-packed depths, watch battles play out turn by turn, and grow stronger every run. Death just sends you home with the loot. Merge gear, buy upgrades, descend again.

title: Night of the Idle Horde
synopsis: Eat the world in this idle, incremental homage to B-movie horror classics. Start as a lowly Shambler and grow into a massive horde. Recruit evil little critters to automate brain collection and buy upgrades for your army. Unleash a mini apocalypse with Desktop Companion Mode.

title: One More Claw
synopsis: 3D physics claw machine + roguelike building. Land it in the chute; blast the target with base times multiplier.

title: Watermellionaire
synopsis: Watermellionaire is a dark battle royale fruit-matching game. Pitted against other employees, you compete to become the Most Valuable Packer (MVP) - those who fail are fired. Faced with nothing but a box, some fruit and a guard watching your every move, only one person can come out on top.

title: Dreadgence
synopsis: A deterministic horror autobattler. Bind extinct monsters as Pacts, arm them with Rites and Relics, then deploy. Your units fight automatically with no mid-battle commands you win by building the right answer before combat begins. Conquer wounds, deepen your Pacts, and automate what you've mastered.

title: Feed the Vessel
synopsis: A Short Active Incremental game where you grow clones in vats, feed them to the entity, butcher and burn them for meat, blood, and ichor, upgrade your ship's stations, push the engine into overdrive, and reach the other side.

title: White Christmas
synopsis: White Christmas is a cozy multiplayer winter playground set in a snowy village. Build snowmen, trade gifts, rent skates, throw snowballs, and warm up at the Christmas market. Host a village with friends and turn a school-free snow day into shared holiday chaos.

title: The Scratcher
synopsis: A roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are scratch tickets. Scratch to fight, push your luck for the jackpot and stop before you go bust. Build a deck of tickets and climb from the Shantytown to the King's Palace.

title: Chrono Cards
synopsis: Chrono Cards is a digital PVP card game that puts you in the role of a time traveler, summoning cards from across history and manipulating time itself to triumph over your opponent. The game is built around its unique Timeline mechanic which splits the board into Past, Present, and Future regions that move on every turn, forcing players to carefully plan ahead and adapt to a constantly evolving board state.

title: Mizi No!: Hobby Time
synopsis:
We all have hobbies, and so does Mizi! Her favorite hobby? Lovingly undoing whatever you just spent hours creating.

Assembled a miniature mech? Finished a beautiful scrapbook page? Spent all evening crocheting something cute? Haha... yeah, we hope you loved it enough to do it all over again. ;)

The "Hobby Time" DLC adds 20 more items for you to put together all over again.

title: Socks Pair Up
synopsis: Socks Pair Up is a cozy first-person game about pairing up and sorting socks to get a specialty sock shop ready to open. Players match socks by color, pattern, and length, then arrange the pairs on shelves, in boxes, on clips, and on mannequins. Displaying pairs earns rewards and skill upgrades that make sorting and stocking easier, while completing shelves opens more of the shop.

title: No One Owns the Light
synopsis: This is the story of the first person in the world to be put to death in an electric chair.

title: Code Market
synopsis: Your store. Your robot. Your code. Code Market is a relaxed management game where you don't click to sell — you program. A robot works in your supermarket, and it does exactly what your Java code tells it: walk to a rack, pick up tomatoes, take a customer's order, pack the bag.

title: Savebot: The Last Garden
synopsis:
Savebot: The Last Garden is a calm programming game about robots who bring a planet back to life.

The player writes programs, block by block, to teach a few robots that know nothing yet how to take care of a sleeping planet, until life comes back on its own across five worlds.

title: Nullnest
synopsis: Defend the Core in this incremental tower defense. Survive relentless enemy waves, unlock new abilities, and collect gems of different rarities that completely transform each run. Experiment with endless combinations and create unique strategies to overcome ever-growing challenges.

title: Orcthal
synopsis: You are the raid. Play as an orc warrior carving through armies! Auto-cast devastating abilities, level up with powerful perks, loot the fallen, pillage their settlements and come back again, and again, stronger!

title: Trust Me Fellow
synopsis: Trust Me Fellow is a psychological deduction puzzle game in which the player is a blind dealer. The player's cards are hidden from them but visible to an audience of characters, who give hints about what each card is. Some audience members tell the truth and some lie. The goal is to flip every O card; flipping a single X card ends the game.

title: Sort Memes Together
synopsis: A meme store has exploded! Grab, stack and throw 80 meme products with up to 3 friends in online co-op, sort every cat loaf, stonks bust and pet rock onto the right shelf, and turn total brainrot chaos into the tidiest meme shop on the internet.

title: Dawn of Defense
synopsis: Dawn of Defense blends RTS, Tower Defense, and Roguelite progression. In a last defense, lead your tribe against the Empire: Command warriors in battle, fortify defenses, and build an economy as you fight to reclaim your ancestral homeland.

title: Star-Coat
synopsis: Star-Coat is a third person shooter where you dive into procedurally generated maps to fight corrupted enemies and the bosses that command them. Outfit your pilot and your COAT, a fearsome walker, with a variety of weapons and armor to help you defeat evil in the universe.

title: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business
originalTitle: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business
synopsis: Join our mercenary team: high-risk, low-benefit positions available! Defend cargo trains in this innovative Turn-Based Tower Defense meets Reverse Bullet Hell. Deploy units, merge them to create powerful new types and variations, withstand relentless waves, deliver the goods.

title: Milki Delivery
synopsis: Grab your bike and milk bottles, let's hit the road! Explore the countryside in this short cozy delivery adventure. Befriend folks and gently help them rebuild their community, one bottle at a time. Upgrade your bike, your dairy farm, and venture deeper into a once-lively region.

title: Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem
synopsis: Spellfall: Mages & Mayhem is a fast-paced, top-down PvP arena brawler where up to six mages compete across seven rounds of magical mayhem. Draft new spells and items between rounds, create increasingly powerful builds, and outlast your opponents as the arena crumbles beneath your feet.

title: Okurek
synopsis: Tend the farm, the chickens, the grieving jars. The trees murmur while the cancer grows with every passing day. A 90-min folk-horror experience set in the rotting mountains of Czech Switzerland. Preserve what you couldn't save.

title: Zero Sum
synopsis: A hand-drawn twin-stick roguelite where every bullet is an equation and every enemy is a number. Subtract, divide, root, modulo. 7 operators, 22 firing modes, 9 bosses, 80+ upgrades. Reduce them all to zero. No health bars, just raw arithmetic violence. You failed math class. Math didn't forget.

title: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic
synopsis: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the series. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.

title: Night Train Simulator: Blackout
synopsis: A slow-burn psychological horror train simulator. Drive the train. Follow the schedule. Ignore what's outside.

title: Ball Picker: Clean Up the Golf Yard
originalTitle: Ball Picker: Clean Up the Golf Yard
synopsis: Collect +1,000,000 golf balls, earn money, buy new vehicles, and clean up the golf yard. Ball Picker - Clean up the Golf Yard is an active incremental game centered on an organizing and relaxing experience.

title: Uncosy
synopsis: An uncomfortable game about collecting plushies.

title: Monkeys!!
synopsis: A romanti-slapstick comedy visual novel from the creative team at HARUKAZE. Saruyoshi, the world's greatest delinquent, must infiltrate the world's most prestigious school for ladies in order to save his boys'-school comrades!

title: Ratchet & Clank
synopsis: A port of Ratchet & Clank, originally released on PS2, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Steel Gullet
synopsis: Build a massive factory aboard a moving ark. Melt, separate, and refine chaotic scrap using realistic thermodynamics. Process materials by mass instead of items, craft based on material properties, and optimize complex production lines in strictly limited space.

title: Game Shelver 99: I Must Organize My Steam Library and Defend It Against Pirates With a Shotgun
originalTitle: Game Shelver 99: I Must Organize My Steam Library and Defend It Against Pirates With a Shotgun
synopsis: Game Shelver 99 is a satirical first-person organizing game set in a retro PC game store. Sort game boxes onto shelves by genre, tags, year, developer, title, or price, then defend your carefully arranged collection from waves of software pirates. Play solo or team up with up to three friends, or choose a peaceful mode focused entirely on organizing.

title: Dravora
synopsis: A dark fantasy narrative roguelite about three lives on one hard road: a fallen mercenary, an oath-singer's apprentice, and the youngest of three fen brothers. No combat screens. Every choice is made in words, and every choice follows you down the road.

title: Futa: Beer & Sex
synopsis: Futa: Beer & Sex is a fast adult arcade game. The player catches beer to unlock three futa bartenders and an uncensored animated sex gallery. The game contains explicit sexual content.

title: Angel Investor Simulator
synopsis: Invest into promising startups with sometimes wacky ideas. Help them grow with your team of experts. Capture the market share with quality product, smart pricing and marketing. Cash out big after the IPO. Compete with the other angels and show them who's the boss.

title: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 2
synopsis:
A port of Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 2, originally released on PlayStation 2, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

In this sequel to the critically acclaimed Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver, reassume the role of Raziel, and battle back through the currents of time into pivotal, dangerous eras of Nosgoth's past in your relentless pursuit of Kain. Encounter new enemies as you unearth the mysteries of Nosgoth's ancient races, and expose the schemes that lie behind the corruption of the Pillars, and the terrible vampire genocide.

title: Space Station Designer
synopsis: Space Station Designer is a construction and management game that puts you in charge of creating and expanding a network of orbital outposts in Earth and Lunar orbits.

title: Eletta
synopsis: Explore an unfamiliar place filled with powerful enemies, advanced technology and scientific advancements in Eletta, an action game about a young girl looking for a way back home.

title: Vice: Magic City Mayhem
synopsis: Vice: Magic City Mayhem is a retro action-adventure game where you fight, collect new items, and upgrade your character as you make your way through bustling nightclubs, scenic beaches, and raptor-infested yachts.

title: Grand Theft Auto VI
synopsis: Grand Theft Auto VI heads to the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond in the biggest, most immersive evolution of the Grand Theft Auto series yet.

title: Fable
synopsis: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

title: Exodus
synopsis: Step forward into Exodus — a cinematic, single-player action RPG set in a new, far-future sci-fi universe. Rise from salvager to Traveler, discover new worlds ravaged by the effects of time, and search for the key to humanity’s survival across the most dangerous reaches of space.

title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
synopsis: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is a reimagining of Lara Croft’s 1996 genre-defining game with visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

title: Silver Palace
synopsis: Silver Palace is an upcoming open‑world detective action‑adventure RPG developed by Silver Studio and published by Elementa worldwide. It is set in the sprawling Victorian‑style metropolis of Sylvanea, built upon the revolutionary element known as Silver Liquid that has fueled its industrial and social transformation. Players assume the role of a detective tasked with unraveling complex criminal conspiracies and uncovering hidden truths scattered throughout the city. The game seamlessly blends open‑world exploration with dynamic real‑time combat, featuring character switching, skill combos, and QTE‑style finishers. Traversal options include horseback riding, aerial wire‑grappling, and free‑running across richly detailed environments. Silver Palace is built on Unreal Engine 5, delivering high‑fidelity anime‑inspired visuals and cinematic battle sequences. It will be available on PC, major consoles, iOS, and Android devices with pre‑registration now open for global audiences. The title adopts a free‑to‑play model enhanced by gacha mechanics for character and gear progression. An 11‑minute gameplay showcase has been released, offering a deep dive into the game’s mechanics and world‑building. No firm release date has been announced, but further details and developer updates will be shared via the official website and social channels.

title: Stranger Than Heaven
synopsis: Stranger Than Heaven is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by Sega. The game follows a multi-decade story across five eras and five cities, centered on men searching for a place to belong. It combines close-quarters action with narrative elements, historical urban settings, and activities connected to music and performance.

title: Metro 2039
synopsis:
METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

The year is 2039. For a quarter century, the last survivors of nuclear war have been locked in bitter conflict deep in the Metro tunnels beneath the poisoned city of Moscow.

Now, finally, they have been united by a single leader, a fanatical Spartan known as Hunter. But this is no peace: Hunter’s Novoreich regime rules through propaganda and fear, subjugating the population in the name of a new war for the surface against a dark and terrifying enemy.

In the wilderness beyond the city, the reclusive Stranger is haunted by violent waking nightmares. When the ghosts of his past force him out of exile, he must undertake a harrowing journey into the shattered ruins of Moscow, to the one place he swore he’d never go. The Metro.

Experience the most shocking METRO adventure yet in a powerful single-player story that weaves exploration, survival, combat and stealth across a hauntingly beautiful but deadly world with unparalleled immersion.

Inspired by the worldwide best-selling METRO book trilogy by Dmitry Glukhovsky.

title: God of War Laufey
synopsis: God of War: Laufey is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Santa Monica Studio for PlayStation 5. The game follows Laufey, also known as Faye, after she awakens in a strange afterlife realm following her death. To protect Kratos and Atreus, she travels through the Everywhen, an afterlife of the gods where deities from different mythologies compete for power. The game shifts the focus from Kratos to Faye and features sword-based combat, magic, and new supporting characters.

title: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
synopsis: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.

title: Ananta
synopsis: Take on the role of an elite Agent within the A.C.D. (Anti-Chaos Directorate) embarking on an exhilarating adventure through a world that breaks all the rules. Meet a variety of interesting characters, jump into exciting combat, solve challenges and safeguard the balance by overcoming threats to humanity, all while enjoying unparalleled freedom to traverse and discover Nova City on a journey to find out who you really are.

title: Out of Words
synopsis: Find your lost voices in a co-op platformer adventure. Together with a friend, via online cross-platform or couch co-op, explore the wild, colorful realm of Vokabulantis as Kurt and Karla in a story about the first time they held hands — where everything you see is crafted by hand.

title: Lords of the Fallen II
synopsis: Lords of the Fallen 2, the highly anticipated sequel to the game released in 2023, is set to arrive in 2026. The team at Hexworks aims to create a sequel incorporating more commercial elements, particularly in visual design, to attract a broader audience of players.

title: Witchbrook
synopsis: Experience the thrills and pitfalls of school-life in Witchbrook! Discover a spellbinding isometric pixel art world full of charm and intrigue in this richly detailed magical school and town life simulator.

title: Persona 4 Revival
synopsis: Who’s on Air? Legend has it that a mysterious broadcast known as the "Midnight Channel" appears only on rainy nights. The day after it airs, a corpse is found in Inaba, a quiet and peaceful town in rural Japan suddenly thrown into turmoil. To uncover the truth behind these chilling mysteries, you and your friends form an investigation team to unravel the secrets of the Midnight Channel and the bizarre murders. As your adventure unfolds, you face off against "Shadows," eerie manifestations of individuals' darker selves. Together, you awaken a hidden power called "Persona" and embark on a journey to prevent more tragedies while uncovering the truth behind the chaos.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation
synopsis:
As the world teeters on the brink of annihilation, the final battle against Sephiroth begins.
A meteor mars the sky, monstrous planetary guardians wreak havoc across the globe, and the fires of war rage. Now, Cloud and his companions must stand against this chaos to not only decide the planet's fate, but bring a legendary conflict to its conclusion.

In the final chapter of the FINAL FANTASY VII remake project, the scale has never been larger and the stakes have never been higher. Take to the skies and explore a boundless world, fight alongside a fully assembled party, master strategic and dynamic combat, and prepare yourself for the climactic finale.

A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

title: Until Dawn 2
synopsis:
Ready to die for likes? Join a team of ambitious ghost hunters as they chase their next viral hit on a remote island haunted by a woman’s chilling story of demons and ghostly phenomena.

When the tale begins to manifest in terrifying ways, the group will have to fight their own fear—and anything else that gets in their way – to get off the island alive. Their lives are in your hands. Make every choice count.

title: Spine
synopsis: Experience Gun Fu like never before with SPINE, an immersive and highly cinematic action game set in a cyberpunk world. Explore the realistic vision of a near-future with a rebellious street artist Redline and her sentient combat implant, Spine, as they challenge a totalitarian AI regime in search of Redline’s captured brother. Participate in epic gunfights against charismatic opponents, while performing spectacular choreography with firearms!

title: Squadron 42
synopsis: Take the role of a rookie UEE Navy combat pilot in a cinematic single-player epic adventure set in the Star Citizen universe. Battle in the stars and face-to-face as you seamlessly transition between dogfighting and ground combat. Serve aboard a massive Navy capital ship as your custom character interacts and builds relationships with a living, breathing crew. Cutting-edge performance capture brings unprecedented emotion and life to some of your favorite actors. Powered by StarEngine, Squadron 42 pushes gaming graphics and fidelity to the next level.

title: Rayman Legends Retold
synopsis: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

title: Mudang: Two Hearts
synopsis: MUDANG: Two Hearts is a narrative-driven, third-person action adventure that blends tactical stealth, visceral combat, and cinematic storytelling set on a politically volatile Korean peninsula.

title: Acts of Blood
synopsis: Acts of Blood is a Beat ‘em up, Action, 3rd person game which focuses on fast-paced, brutal hand-to-hand combat. Set in dystopian city of Bandung, Indonesia.

title: Turok: Origins
synopsis: Play as the legendary Turok warriors to face off against ferocious dinosaurs and a terrifying alien threat that seeks to destroy all human life across the galaxy.

title: Hela: Of Mice & Magic
synopsis: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

title: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros
originalTitle: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros
synopsis: Classic real-time strategy in the world of Westeros. Conquer the Seven Kingdoms solo, or in treacherous free-for-all multiplayer. Command the Great Houses, rally iconic heroes, and rewrite the fate of the realm. Do you have the strength to seize the Iron Throne?

title: Grave Seasons
synopsis: Grave Seasons is a supernatural murder-mystery farming simulator. Play as the new farmer in Ashenridge as you harvest crops, fish and mine, meet and romance townsfolk, build up the community... and maybe stop the murders.

title: Spyro: A Realm Beyond
synopsis: Take flight in a brand-new journey through a strange and wondrous realm. When Spyro finds himself stranded, his journey to discover a way home is interrupted by the arrival of a vicious invading force known as the Scavs.

title: Clutch
synopsis: Clutch is a cinematic, open-world, action-driving game from the team at Maverick Games - lead by former Forza Horizon Creative Director, Mike Brown, and other senior leads on the franchise.

title: Bellum
synopsis: Bellum is the next evolution of platoon-scale tactical shooters, built in Unreal Engine 5 and shaped by die-hard fans who demanded more from the genre. Set in a fractured Africa of the 2030s, players are thrust into counter-insurgency campaigns where global powers engage in proxy wars across dense jungles, open savannas, and broken urban sprawl. Our unique limited-life system captures the tension of immersive milsim operations while keeping every match accessible, focused, and intense.

title: Showa American Story
synopsis: Showa American Story is a brand new RPG and an enthusiastic love letter to the 80s' pop culture that features a strong taste of B-Movies. Follow Choko's journey of truth and revenge across North America as she grows stronger.

title: Threads of Time
synopsis: Threads of Time is an era-spanning, turn-based RPG inspired by the timeless classics. Embark on a journey through time, gather a party of charismatic heroes from across ages, and uncover a plot that threatens to unravel the past, present and future.

title: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
originalTitle: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
synopsis:
Professor Layton and the New World of Steam depicts the world one year after the events of "Professor Layton and the Unwound Future".

Due to a mysterious incident in Steam Bison, a new adventure for Layton and Luke begins!

title: Armatus
synopsis: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
synopsis: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
synopsis: Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends. In this dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA, players use offensive and defensive Chinese martial arts to fight back against mighty demons on the battlefields of the Three Kingdoms.

title: TankRat
synopsis: A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are. Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.

title: Mariachi Legends
synopsis: Mariachi Legends is an action-packed mystery Metroidvania game. In Mariachi Legends, Join fantastical festivities at the Day of the Dead carnival alongside Detective Pablo Cruz, currently masquerading as a mariachi player to investigate an evil curse looming over the serene town of Santa Mascota.

title: Metroid Ravenous
synopsis: It’s eat or be eaten! Take control of Samus Aran, a renowned bounty hunter ambushed by unknown attackers and marooned on an unfamiliar moon. Gather your arsenal, navigate a maze of corridors, hunt down powerful bosses, and use your newly awakened Metroid instincts to devour your foes. You’ll need to strike quickly and aggressively with beams, missiles, and more—lest you become the enemy’s next meal.

title: Ikuma: The Frozen Compass
synopsis: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

title: Haunted by Femboy
synopsis: In this choice-based NSFW visual novel after inheriting a strange house from your parents, you stumble upon an ancient book and accidentally summon a mischievous femboy ghost. Now bound to your home, the ghost becomes your roommate, and it's up to you to find the missing pages of the book while navigating your unusual new life together.

title: Gundam Rogue Orbit
synopsis: Become the pilot you were born to be. Change humanity’s fate in GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, a high-mobility action game that delivers a bold new take on Gundam, blending a fast-paced cinematic story with intense, hard-hitting combat in an all-new universe.

title: Mega Man: Dual Override
synopsis: Mega Man returns in 2027 with a brand-new entry in the classic action platforming series! Override challenges and blast down legions of robots while springboarding across a new array of futuristic frontiers!

title: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
synopsis: Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.

title: Danganronpa 2x2
synopsis:
A new killing game begins in the same setting and with the same characters as Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair. A brand-new scenario with different victims, culprits, and tricks! Reveal the truth by shooting down contradictions in a Class Trial and uncover the culprit of a murder.

The original scenario from Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair, with revamped visuals and presentation for modern consoles, is also included.

title: Petit Planet
synopsis: Petit Planet is HoYoverse's brand-new cosmic life sim that's free-to-play and cross-platform. Here, you can build your home, live alongside fuzzy neighbors, and discover the infinite possibilities of life on this planet!

title: Dark Mass
synopsis: Dark Mass is a fully underwater horror game. Explore the ruins of a sunken manor and flee from a curse trapped within for centuries. Your choices will decide if you escape or join the lost souls of the abyss.

title: SacriFire
synopsis: A modern JRPG-inspired game with a unique battle system, rich story, fantastic visuals and music by Motoi Sakuraba.

title: Shadow of the Road
synopsis: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

title: Road Kings
synopsis: Drive a 40-ton semi hauling cargo across the coastal plains of the American South, managing multiple jobs, trailers, and routes. Grow reputation from rookie to veteran owner-operator, dodging disasters and rivals to become the hero of the open road.

title: Edge of Memories
synopsis: The Corrosion, a plague of unparalleled proportions, has already ravaged the Astryan continent. On the other side of the world, the continent of Avaris and its nomadic peoples—so far spared from the horrors spawned by this abomination—now stand on the brink of extinction. Eline, an itinerant Soul Whisperer, relentlessly battles the force that turns the once-thriving fauna, flora and humans of this lush land into grotesque abominations. Following a mysterious encounter, a dark power awakens within her, one that may hold the key to ending this apocalypse: the ability to control the Corrosion within her own body.

title: Hunter: The Reckoning - Deathwish
synopsis:
Vampires, Werewolves, Witches. What if I told you that the things that go bump in the night are real? What if I told you that you could see them?

Awaken to the truth you’re now a Hunter. Build your character, select skills, and work with a team of allies to investigate the monsters hidden in plain sight, to find their lairs, and to eradicate them. All the while, investigating a story that drags up memories from your past, ones that could change how you see the future.

Welcome to the World of Darkness.

title: SlashZero
synopsis: SlashZero is a 3D roguelike action platformer. As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world, use combat skills and strategies to piece together the truth, and take down the Lord of the Void! Is what you see the truth?

title: Perceptum
synopsis: A psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. Explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls.

title: Chronoscript: The Endless End
synopsis: Chronoscript: The Endless End is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, an editor trapped within a manuscript, must unravel a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its endacross 2D pages and a 3D manor.

title: Guns of Eschaton
synopsis: The worlds first soulslike FPS pulls you into an apocalyptic Western by the legendary Viktor Antonov: a land of dust, blood, and horror. Study your enemies, count your bullets, forge your own style with gunpowder and prayers. Solo or in co-opgo West, gunslinger, go West and die with the country!

title: Alien Deathstorm
synopsis: Explore a devastated off-world colony that is ravaged by a cataclysmic mega-storm and overrun by bloodthirsty aliens in Alien Deathstorm, the new sci-fi action horror FPS from Rebellion.

title: Enginefall
synopsis: Enginefall is a player-driven crafting shooter set on colossal, post-apocalyptic megatrains. Start in the tail alone or with friends as you scavenge, craft, and build your way to First Class. Seize better gear car by car, and escape with high-value loot to upgrade your personal home on the rails.

title: The Bornless
synopsis:
The Bornless is an FPS action shooter packed with a variety of gameplay modes. Dive into last-man-standing co-op gameplay or try the thrilling demon versus disciple mode, all within a terror-filled world. Players pair up and form teams, conjure demons to aid in combat, and utilize strategic planning and resource management to survive. Whether you choose an aggressive playstyle or prefer a more cautious approach, the choice is yours.

Join or create a Faction and amass various resources to upgrade and enhance your Safehouse or personalize your gear to give a new look to your arsenal as you go to war with other Factions.

You will also experience deep lore and storyline involving all the characters within The Bornless universe, which will be revealed as facts are discovered by players.

title: ReVamp
synopsis: Rule as Dracula in this castle-defense roguelite. Shape your fortress room by room, command an army of monsters, and step into battle yourself to protect your throne from relentless mortal invaders. A war waged for eternity, for the love you couldn’t save.

title: Join Us
synopsis: Lead a cult and prepare for the end of the world in Join Us, the upcoming co-op, open-world survival experience. Ride bears, build up your perfect base, and prepare for the apocalypse.

title: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
originalTitle: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
synopsis: Eternia’s favorite heroes including He-Man, Teela, Man-At-Arms and more in a two-player, retro-inspired 2D magic-brawler, drawn in beautiful pixel-art and featuring huge, highly-detailed sprites, designed to do justice to Eternia’s favorite peace-keepers.

title: Phase Zero
synopsis: A grotesque illness binds the town of Flint Peak. Two survivors try to escape with their lives as mysterious creatures roam the streets. Face horrific monsters, solve puzzles and escape the town in this classic survival horror. Can you make it till dawn?

title: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
synopsis: The shadows are your ally. Return to the city as Garrett, master thief, in this remastered classic by Nightdive Studios. Pickpocket, prowl, and outsmart in a world where trust is a luxury and every stolen secret comes at a price.

title: Canyons
synopsis: Canyons is a third-person extraction shooter set in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Fight for your existence in 4 player co-op or solo, control massive Crawlers, build a settlement for survivors, and conquer this savage world!

title: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus
synopsis: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus is a phantasmagorical voyage through time, myth, divinity, and video games. Escape the lordly deities of the underworld with your soul, and your sanity, intact. This is not a game about ponies.

title: Trine 6: Together in Time
synopsis: Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1-4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide as you solve perplexing puzzles, engage cunning creatures, and traverse perilous paths in the next adventure through Trines iconic fantasy world.

title: Attack on Titan 3
synopsis: Experience the story from beginning to end in the ultimate culmination of the Attack on Titan game series. The ODM action has been further refined, delivering the most exhilarating and stylish combat the series has ever seen.

title: About Fishing
synopsis: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.

title: Shutter Story
synopsis: Your friend is convinced his house is haunted. Examine his family's photo album to reveal signs of the paranormal, as the horror unfolds in the house around you. Their fate is in your hands.

title: Becrowned
synopsis: Surreal survival horror in a world standing between reality and dreams. Unravel all the mysteries of the dark world, escape from your own fears, and explore the terrifying world where fire no longer burns.

title: Stage Tour
synopsis: Stage Tour is a rhythm-action game that blends familiar, accessible note-highway gameplay with exciting modern twists. It’s poised to rekindle the flame of plastic-instrument rhythm gaming with new features and modes, diverse bandmates and instruments, competitive depth, and seasonal events.

title: Animal Use Protocol
synopsis: In this first-person, narrative-focused survival horror, you play as Penn, a hyper-intelligent chimpanzee. Hunted at every turn, your only chance of survival lies in scavenging, crafting, and exploring Anchorage Station. An epic story awaits. Be quick and quiet. Time is running out...

title: Croak
synopsis: Croak is a nimble -and challenging- precision platformer featuring an innovative grapple mechanic. Use the prince’s tongue to dash and bounce around through hundreds of hand-crafted rooms. Manipulate the environment as you traverse distinct biomes, each with unique gameplay mechanics and bosses.

title: Kirby and the World Beyond
synopsis: Get ready to freely explore the World Beyond using Copy Abilities in Kirby and the World Beyond, the latest 3D Kirby adventure, coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in spring 2027!

title: Elta: Defy All Gods
synopsis: Brawl your way out of corrupted worlds alongside your dragon-god companion in an adrenaline-fueled action-platformer blending free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration. Become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.

title: Arizona Sunshine
synopsis: Sharpen your machete and grab your friends. Arizona Sunshine brings its award-winning zombie apocalypse to explosive third-person action, featuring online and split-screen co-op, brutal combat, dark humor, and Buddy, your loyal zombie-chomping canine companion.

title: Haunted Paws
synopsis: Haunted Paws is a Cozy Coop Horror game where you will play as two Puppies trying to rescue their human friend in a haunted mansion. Create your puppy, explore spooky environments and defeat evil creatures in an action packed adventure!

title: Silent Planet: Elegy of a Dying World
originalTitle: Silent Planet: Elegy of a Dying World
synopsis: Silent Planet is an exploration-focused, dark action side-scroller rooted in Cosmic horror. Explore the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a dead civilization.

title: Prison of Husks
synopsis: A nostalgic souls-like set in a painted afterlife. Awaken as a doll and seek your beloved. From parries to pistols, tune your build to overcome adversity. Explore dense, interconnected levels full of secrets and shortcuts as you battle pigment-hoarding bosses and seek your lost love.

title: Muramasa: Revenant Blades
synopsis: Vanillaware x Marvelous present an action RPG for the ages. Hack and slash your way through a world of restless spirits and Demon Blades. The tales of six fabled protagonists of Japan's Genroku era, each with their own unique fighting style, are about to unfold.

title: Tempus Vitae
synopsis: You are Alex, a time-displaced astronaut unraveling the space station Theia doomed in both the war-torn 2185 and the post-apocalyptic 2385 to find your lost brother. Master an arsenal of time travel abilities and weapons in this sci-fi metroidvania FPS: Tempus Vitae.

title: Tropico 7
synopsis: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

title: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
originalTitle: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
synopsis: A story-driven, atmospheric thriller with pixel-art graphics and survival-horror elements. Short, intense, and unforgettable.

title: Petal Runner
synopsis: Hop on your bike and join Cali & Kira as they explore the sun-soaked city of Sapphire Valley and train to become Petal Runners! Make deliveries, meet new friends, play minigames, and discover a wholesome slice-of-life story about growing up and letting go.

title: Azur Promilia
synopsis: Azur Promilia is a fantasy world RPG with creature companionship. Step into a fantasy world, utterly different from the world you know. The world of various civilizations, magic and incredible fantasy creatures, together with tales echoing in the starry sky. Take a daring leap from the sky into the ocean, to once again encounter and bond with new life. Guided by shooting stars, amid the sparkling constellations, this is your very own journey. The entire universe eagerly anticipates the ballad of stars and odyssey, exclusively yours to unfold.

title: Usual June
synopsis: Hang out, fight monsters, and discover your town’s darkest secrets in Usual June, a third person action game about summer break and the end of the world.

title: Crescent County
synopsis: Crash headfirst into this witch-tech open world, drifting and driving on the back of your new motorbroom. Make deliveries, trick out your broom, and race your new friends (and crushes) as the sun sets. Decorate your flat, sort your life out, and discover what it means to find home.

title: Lost Hellden
synopsis: Lost Hellden is a unique 3D hand-painted J-RPG from Artisan Studios, enhanced by dynamic lighting and weather effects. Follow Cyphel and his allies as a mature story unfolds. Customize your characters as you see fit and dive into a battle system that mixes action and strategy.

title: Toxic Crusaders
synopsis: The Toxic Crusaders return for an all-new, all-action beat 'em up for one to four players! Grab your mop, tutu and attitude, and get ready to clean up the mean streets of Tromaville, one radioactive goon at a time!

title: Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino
synopsis: "Where will their light lead them?" Kitsune is a fox girl who finds herself on Adashino Island and starts travelling with her Frog friend. Neon signs give light and color to the island with a Japanese-inspired atmosphere. Something is lurking in the shadows, inching ever closer...

title: Demi and the Fractured Dream
synopsis: In this action adventure, play as Demi and venture through the wondrous world of Somnus. Tasked by a mysterious voice, you must destroy the legendary Accursed Beasts to save the world. Use your attacks and abilities to slay enemies, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind an ancient history.

title: Son of Thanjai
synopsis: Son of Thanjai is a cinematic action-adventure epic set in the culturally rich 11th-century South India. As a Chola king burdened by legacy, you must embark on a personal journey that blurs the line between duty and destiny. Will you rise as a legend–or be forgotten?

title: Arcane Eats
synopsis: A roguelike deckbuilder with a delicious twist. Think like a master chef, balancing resources as you strategically combo ingredients to subdue hungry hordes. Recruit a legendary kitchen crew, and rise through the heroic cooking guilds—before The Hunger consumes us all!

title: Skyblivion
synopsis:
Skyblivion is the ultimate fan-made experience for the Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion, bringing the game into the newer engine of the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. This process combines Oblivion’s impressive award-winning open-world that is renowned for its incredible gameplay, memorable quests, and expansive world space with the advancements in gaming that have been made in the last two decades. Set in the Elder Scroll’s Third Era, during the cataclysmic Oblivion Crisis, you must help to restore the Imperial throne and repel the demonic Daedric invasion.

Skyblivion will feature the remastered entirety of Oblivion’s mainland, Cyrodiil, from the wintery slopes of the Valus and Jerall Mountains to the swamps of Blackwood and warm-beachy shores of the Gold Coast. Skyblivion will bring the return of many classic Oblivion mechanics like spell crafting, a complete class and attributes system, underwater combat, and NPC disposition.

In addition to recreating Oblivion’s systems and porting them into the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim’s engine the project has taken great care in providing new improvements and additions. Skyblivion offers fans remastered graphics, weather, and lighting, an expanded soundtrack, new gameplay mechanics, and even a limited selection of bespoke minor quests with original voice acting to further flesh out barren areas of Oblivion—all for free!

Once Skyblivion is released in 2025, fans will have access to the entirety of Oblivion’s pre-DLC world space, systems, and quests available for play. But that’s not the end of the project! Following a period of bug-fixing and community-supported updates the project development team will move on to working on Oblivion’s nine additional content releases plus the Shivering Isles expansion.

With Skyblivion you experience the best of both worlds: The complex and detailed RPG experience of Oblivion paired with Skyrim’s newer systems, graphics, and quality of life improvements. Will you close shut the jaws of Oblivion once more in 2025?

title: Surviving Deponia
synopsis: Explore, craft, build and fight your way through the harsh landscape of Deponia. Meet allies and make enemies while surviving the perils of the junk planet. It might be garbage - but it’s your garbage!

title: Bloody Hell Hotel
synopsis: In Bloody Hell Hotel, you embody a vampire. You wake up from a coma that has lasted for centuries, only to find your once-grand estate is now in ruins. It's time to turn it into a prosperous hotel! It's no easy task, though, as times are tough and resources are scarce. There are shortages of food, supplies, and workforce. Being a blood-thirsty monster doesn't help with customer satisfaction either. Luckily, underneath the estate lies a crypt and a system of caves. By foraging, farming, crafting, and fighting your way through the monster-infested dungeons, you'll find the resources you need to restore greatness to your mansion and turn it into a thriving hotel business.

title: Fate/Extra Record
synopsis:
The “Moon Holy Grail War” begins anew…

The setting is a Spiritron virtual world called “SE.RA.PH.” built on the moon. Masters and Servants team up and fight for survival in pursuit of the “Holy Grail,” an omnipotent wish-granting device, in the Moon Holy Grail War which begins once again…

This is a remake of Fate/EXTRA, the first Fate series RPG originally released on July 22, 2010, now revamped for modern hardware with an expanded scenario, refreshed character graphics, and dramatic command battles utilizing a highly strategic deck-building system.

title: Mr. Records
synopsis: ​Meet George, an old dreamer with an extraordinary gift that lets him transcend through music. After a lifetime of standing still, he breaks free from routine and opens the store he always wished for. ​

title: Rayman Origins: Enhanced Edition
synopsis:
When the Glade of Dreams is overrun by “nefurrious” Darktoons, the Fairy Council summons Rayman to save the day. Joined by his best friend, Globox, and two crafty wizards, the Teensies, this unlikely team must restore balance before their world fades away like a bad dream.

Enjoy Rayman Origins like never before with 4K resolution, 60 FPS, and modern enhancements, including new quality-of-life features. Discover 60 hidden Relics across the adventure and track your progress in the Snoring Tree.
